title: Eat
subtitle: 「吃／試吃／品嚐／攝取／享用／狼吞虎嚥」，究竟是哪一種 eat？
description: 「吃／試吃／品嚐／攝取／享用／狼吞虎嚥」，究竟是哪一種 eat？

words.note: 使用者提供。當 eat 指只吃一小口或少量食物，目的是判斷味道、品質或是否喜歡時，sample 很自然。它強調少量試吃，而不是完整進食。
words.example: Visitors can sample several local cheeses at the market.

exercises.original: Guests were invited to eat several dishes before choosing their favourite.
exercises.zh: 賓客獲邀先品嚐數款菜式，再選出最喜歡的一款。

options.explanation: before choosing their favourite 表示只需試吃少量來比較，最適合 sample。

falseSynonyms.zh: sample 只表示吃少量來試味或評估；完整吃一餐通常不能叫 sample。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Visitors sampled three cheeses. They ate dinner at seven.

falseSynonyms.zh: try 強調體驗某種食物，常見第一次；不一定表示吃完，也不特別強調味道判斷。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON You should try the soup. He ate the entire bowl.

falseSynonyms.zh: taste 強調用味覺判斷味道，常只需一小口；eat 不需要這個目的。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Taste the sauce before serving. She ate a bowl of rice.

falseSynonyms.zh: consume 是較正式用語，常見於營養、研究、標籤與政策；日常餐桌對話通常用 eat/have。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Adults should consume enough fibre. We had pasta for dinner.

falseSynonyms.zh: eat 通常用於固體食物；drink 用於液體。某些食物如 soup 可因語境而用 eat 或 have。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON He ate the sandwich. He drank the juice.

falseSynonyms.zh: feed 通常是『餵』某人／動物，或 feed on 表物種食性；不能直接把一般 eat 換成 feed。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She fed the baby. The birds feed on seeds.

falseSynonyms.zh: chew 只是咀嚼，不保證吞下；eat 包括整個進食行為。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Chew the food slowly. He ate the meal.

falseSynonyms.zh: eat 是動詞；edible 是形容詞，表示可食用，詞性與意思不同。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON They ate the berries. The berries are edible.
